name: Dumbbell-Assisted Chin-Up
description: Chin-up with dumbbell between feet for progressive overload on lats and biceps.
setup: Grip overhead bar with underhand grip, feet holding dumbbell.
execution: Pull chin over bar by driving elbows down, lower with control.
breathing: Exhale on pull, inhale on lower

name: Reverse-Grip Dumbbell Row
description: Underhand row emphasizing lower lats and biceps for V-taper width.
setup: One hand and knee on bench, other foot on floor, underhand grip on dumbbell.
execution: Row dumbbell to hip, squeezing lower lat, lower with control.
breathing: Exhale on row, inhale on lower
progression: Heavier weight or pause at contraction

name: Dumbbell Kroc Row
description: Heavy cheat row pushing maximum weight for back thickness with controlled form breakdown.
setup: Hand on bench, heavy dumbbell in working hand, slight body English allowed.
execution: Pull heavy dumbbell to hip with slight body momentum, control the negative fully.
safety_notes: Experienced lifters only; lower back tolerance needed
